module: Flowgraph node 'Flow Switch' (logic category). Switch with flow inputs 'on' and 'off'; the state can also be toggled by clicking the checkbox on the node in the editor. The flow output equals the input flow if the switch is ON. The initial state is saved in the project (storedOn).
notes: If storedOn has never been set (nil), _executionStarted sets self.on to nil, which is equivalent to OFF.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws a clickable checkbox; a click toggles the state and, if editing is allowed, stores storedOn.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads storedOn back from the 'on' field.

work.desc: If 'on' has flow, switches to ON; if 'off' has flow, switches to OFF (off wins if both). Output flow = state AND input flow.
